title: Tower Defense Macro
features:
Universal Tower Defense X — Script Features

Macro System
• Record & Playback
• Auto Replay Macro (per game)
• Auto Equip Units from Macro
• Create / Delete / Manage Macro Files
• Full action & ability support

Auto Join
• Story Mode (Story / Act / Difficulty)
• Legend Stage
• Virtual Realm
• Challenge (with Ignore Half-Hour + Auto Lobby on reset)
• Featured Challenge
• Raids / World Raid
• Rifts / Portal (Portal Tier select)
• Limited Time Modes
• Friend-Only / Difficulty Meter / Start Delay
• Auto Create & Auto Start Room

In-Game Automation
• Auto Start
• Auto Game Speed (x1 / x1.5)
• Auto Replay / Auto Next / Auto Leave
• Skip Reward
• Place Anywhere

Blessing / Card System
• Auto Select Card
• Path Priority selection
• Adjustable Select Delay

Relic System
• Auto Sell Relic
• Filter by Rarity / Stars / SubStats

Auto Claim
• Redeem Codes
• Quests / Events / Battlepass

Shop
• Auto Buy All in Merchant
• Auto Buy Raid Shop (selectable items + amount)

Minigame
• Auto Click Prompt In Match
• Auto QTE (Rohan)

Webhook (Discord)
• End-game match result
• User Ping support
• Hide Player Name option

Misc
• Switch Map
• Multi-Config Save / Load
• Custom UI Theme
